summary: Full end-to-end test of SmartDry Connect. All 8 backend pytest cases pass (telemetry, seeded batches 083-090, get/create/patch batch, energy summary, system status). Frontend: dashboard renders with demo-data-banner, dryer-status-badge=RUNNING, active-batch-id=SDC-2026-090; all 7 sidebar nav testids present and route correctly; Live Monitor START/PAUSE/STOP works, gauges (temp/humidity/gas/progress) render, telemetry LineChart plots after START; New Batch form has all fields with proper data-testids and required-field validation; Batch History table renders 10 rows (8 seeded + 2 from backend tests) with search & product filter; Energy & Performance renders KPI cards, energy split donut, comparison table with SIMULATED COMPARISON badge and no invented % savings claims; QR Traceability renders real qr-code-canvas; /trace/SDC-2026-083 passport route renders directly; System Status shows architecture diagram + 8 component health matrix + telemetry stream log.

issues: Recharts console warnings 'width(-1) and height(-1)... should be greater than 0' when the chart container mounts before ResponsiveContainer measures. Non-blocking; charts still render correctly once tab is active.

action_items: (Optional) Suppress Recharts container-size warnings by giving ResponsiveContainer explicit minHeight or by rendering chart only after tab is visible.

(Optional) In Traceability.jsx line ~55, avoid a nested span inside <option> (dev-tool instrumentation produces a React hydration warning about span cannot be child of option). Purely a dev-instrumentation artifact but noisy in console.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py auto-batch-id generation logic in POST /api/batches is convoluted and may collide (uses `91 + count - 8` then random fallback). Consider a cleaner monotonic scheme based on max(existing suffix)+1.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event startup/shutdown — migrate to lifespan context manager for FastAPI >=0.109.

Backend logger is instantiated AFTER seed_batches uses it (logger.info at line 96 references module-level logger which is defined at line 287). Works because startup runs after import, but ordering is confusing.
No pagination on GET /api/batches (hardcoded to_list(500)) — acceptable for demo, flag for production.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created 2 extra batches (SDC-2026-091 Ginger, SDC-2026-092 Herbs COMPLETE) that now appear in Batch History alongside seeded 083-090.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. All key data-testids present and functional. Live Monitor chart takes ~3-10s after START to plot points (3s tick). New Batch form fields: batch-id-input, product-select, starting-weight-input, tray-quantity-input, operator-input, drying-method-select, start-datetime-input, new-batch-submit-btn. tray-quantity defaults to 24 and starting-weight/operator are required (correctly validated).
